hook: Your Street View here was filmed by sheep.
title: Sheep Filmed Street View of Faroe Islands
description:
The Faroe Islands lacked Google Street View coverage, so locals strapped solar-powered 360 cameras onto sheep and made Sheep View 360. It really happened. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #FaroeIslands #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you trust a sheep? Yes or no
